name: Pan-Fried Pork Chops with Pear, Arugula & Walnut Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula
3 pears

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan / skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, bone-in
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the grill pan / skillet is hot, coat the bottom with coconut oil.

Place the pork chops in the grill pan / skillet and sear until they develop a nice crust, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Then, reduce the heat to medium and cook the chops, flipping occasionally, until they are cooked through (test using a thermometer or cut into a chop with a knife), another 3 to 5 minutes. Once done, transfer the pork to a plate.
Transfer the arugula to a large bowl.
Quarter the pears lengthwise, then cut out the core and stem from each section; cut each section lengthwise into 4 thin wedges and transfer to the bowl with the arugula.
Roughly chop the walnuts and leave on cutting board.
In a small bowl, combine and whisk together olive oil, balsamic vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 ½ tsp honey
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drizzle the dressing over the arugula and pears; toss to coat.
To serve, divide the salad between plates and sprinkle with the walnuts; place the pork chops next to the salad. Enjoy!
